summary: Refresh the TypeScript client installation hash after the effect-utils fd39f4ff pin update so Nix release builds accept the deterministic installation output.

replay.detail: No claim or replay behavior change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Nix consumers use the corrected installation output hash with the existing effect-utils fd39f4ff source identity; runtime interfaces and dependency versions are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The installation hash correction does not require a daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action is required; Nix uses the corrected pin on the next build.

recovery.detail: No data recovery is needed. Revert this hash correction only together with the corresponding effect-utils input change to restore the previous dependency installation.
